name: BioDSH
title_zh: 临床医生与湿实验科学家的本地生信工作台
tagline_zh: 装一次，离线跑通生信分析全流程：一键安装器、技能商店、DeepSeek 本地推理。不联网也能出结果。
tagline_en: One-click installers, a skill store, and offline DeepSeek reasoning. Run bioinformatics pipelines without cloud.
desc_en: The bioinformatics agent desktop for clinicians and wet-lab scientists — built on DeepSeek Harness. One-click installers, a skill store, offline mode.
why_zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的推理能力直接嵌进桌面端，技能商店按需加载。
why_en: Embeds DeepSeek Harness reasoning into a desktop app with a curated skill store. Offline-first design keeps experiments.
limit_zh: 只覆盖生信分析场景，不处理影像或电子病历；需自备计算资源（建议 16GB 内存以上）；技能商店内容依赖社区更新。
limit_en: Bioinformatics only; no imaging or EHR. Needs 16GB+ RAM. Skill store depends on community updates; offline mode requires local model files.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Local bioinformatics desktop for clinicians and wet-lab.
